feat(pjm): measured seam ladder — Q-Q tie-line x DA quantile band prices (audit C-6 closure for the priced seam)

pjm-95 C1 root-cause lead: the spot-spread reference seam imports in 46% of
2023 hours vs measured ~2% (diurnal corr -0.50) — phantom imports displacing
CC_REGULAR dispatch (C1 FAIL 2023 -14.1 TWh). The measured PJM interchange
is direction-structural (export to MISO/NYISO in ~97-100% of ALL hours,
import from Carolinas/TVA/LGEE in 77-97% — firm PTP schedules revealed only
statistically), which the hurdle-gated gas x HR x load-shape formula inverts.

The MISO/NEISO measured-ladder pattern applied to PJM:

- scripts/derive_pjm_seam_ladders.py — Q-Q duration coupling of PJM's
  settlement-grade tie-line flows (pooled onto the five priced seams by the
  new interchange_config.PJM_SEAM_TIE) with the measured PJM DA system LMP.
  Offline P9: every seam volume within +/-0.06 TWh of measured, import-hour
  shares 0-2% vs measured 0-2% (MISO/NYISO), duration RMSE 40-275 MW.
  Boundary note (rule 14): PJM's EIA-930 submission disagrees with both the
  tie meter and the counterparty meters on the MISO seam (2023: 56.6 vs
  35.3 vs MISO's own 33.5 TWh) — the tie-line file (the model's canonical
  boundary) is the flow source; the 930 parquet is the printed cross-check.
- interchange_config.PJM_SEAM_LADDER_BY_YEAR (2023/2024/2025 measured
  ladders + full provenance comment); the static PJM tranches re-labelled
  (they serve only the static-node path).
- transmission.inject_pjm_seam_ladder_prices via the shared
  _inject_seam_ladder core (the MISO injector delegates, byte-identical);
  DISPLACES the firm scheduled-export floor on ladder years (rule 19 —
  alternatives, never stacked).
- ScenarioConfig.pjm_seam_measured_ladder (tier 1) +
  --pjm-seam-measured-ladder, threaded through run_calibration(_full) with
  meta.json round-trip (replay-safe).
- build_dof_ledger: PJM seam bands flip residual -> measured-physical under
  the flag; residual-row scope re-worded.
- tests/test_pjm_seam_ladder.py — registry shape/ordering/no-wash,
  injection, firm-floor displacement (19 tests).
- scripts/probes/_pjm_temp_capability_envelope.py + the calibration-log
  entry for this session (the demotion's evidence; the registry/attestation
  edits land in the companion commit).
- .github/workflows/fetch-pjm-interchange.yml — runner intake for the
  EIA-930 PJM cross-check parquet (the NYISO intake pattern; the ladder
  itself derives from the committed tie-line CSVs, and the derive script
  skips the cross-check gracefully while the parquet is absent).

Identification: measured-behaviour, frozen formula, zero fitted parameters
(rule 23); re-derives only when the source data extends. Forecast years keep
the gas-elastic reference formula (two-track, like hr_by_year).
